init_hook: if ! rustc_bin="$(rustup which --toolchain "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN}" rustc 2>/dev/null)" || [ ! -x "${rustc_bin}" ]; then rustup toolchain uninstall "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN}" || true; rustup toolchain install "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN}" --profile minimal; fi
rustup target list --installed --toolchain "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN}" | grep -qx wasm32-unknown-unknown || rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown --toolchain "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN}"
rustup component list --toolchain "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN}" --installed | grep -Eq '^rustfmt' || rustup component add rustfmt --toolchain "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN}"
rustup component list --toolchain "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN}" --installed | grep -Eq '^clippy' || rustup component add clippy --toolchain "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN}"
export PATH="$(dirname "$(rustup which --toolchain "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN}" cargo)"):$(dirname "$(rustup which --toolchain "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN}" rustc)"):${CARGO_HOME}/bin:${PATH}"

check: RUSTC="$(rustup which --toolchain "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN:-stable}" rustc)" cargo check --workspace --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
clippy: RUSTC="$(rustup which --toolchain "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN:-stable}" rustc)" cargo clippy --workspace --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings
ci:web-ui: (cd web-ui && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run check && pnpm test && pnpm run build)
